intents.boundary: A greeting only; it must not communicate instructions or promises.

intents.publicDescription: Ask how staff can help with a routine reception need.
intents.boundary: General reception help only; consequential topics require another communication method.

intents.publicDescription: Ask the visitor to type their name and who they are visiting.
intents.boundary: Request typing only; do not sign a person's name, identity, or other variable detail.

intents.publicDescription: Say that staff will notify the visitor's host.
intents.boundary: Do not identify the host or promise an arrival time.

intents.publicDescription: Ask the visitor to wait in the reception area.
intents.boundary: Do not state a precise wait time or use this during an emergency.

intents.publicDescription: Explain that there is a short, unspecified delay.
intents.boundary: No exact duration, cause, guarantee, or consequential explanation.

intents.publicDescription: Ask the visitor to follow a staff member.
intents.boundary: Routine wayfinding only; not evacuation, security, medical, or legal direction.

intents.publicDescription: Offer to show the visitor the way.
intents.boundary: Offer assistance only; do not encode a variable route or destination in the clip.

intents.publicDescription: Ask to repeat or try the communication again.
intents.boundary: A neutral repair request only; do not imply that the visitor is at fault.

intents.publicDescription: Offer typing, captions, or qualified communication support.
intents.boundary: Do not promise immediate interpreter availability or describe this product as an interpreter.
